name: Returning the Lost Satchel
summary: In Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, the search for Maur Grimtotem ends with his satchel. You must carry it back to Rahauro on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: A Grim Discovery
sections.body: Maur Grimtotem was slain by troggs in the fiery depths of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. Even in death, his arms clung to his personal satchel. Freeing it from his grip is the only clue to why a member of the Grimtotem clan entered the volcanic caverns beneath Thrall's capital.

sections.title: Magatha's Interest
sections.body: Rahauro receives the satchel gratefully on Elder Rise and seeks answers about why one of Magatha Grimtotem's clan died needlessly. Magatha Grimtotem herself oversaw the effort, and Rahauro gives a reward authorized by the Elder Crone. What Maur carried, or why Magatha sent him into Orgrimmar's trogg-infested fissures, is known only to Grimtotem leadership.

faq.answer: Maur Grimtotem's corpse lies deep in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, surrounded by hostile troggs.

faq.q: Who do I turn the satchel in to?
faq.answer: Bring the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why was Maur Grimtotem in Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Rahauro says he does not know why Magatha's clansman had to die needlessly. Magatha Grimtotem personally ordered the recovery effort, suggesting Maur may have been acting on clan business.

faq.q: What is inside the Grimtotem Satchel?
faq.answer: The satchel's contents are never revealed to the courier. Maur guarded it fiercely until his death, and it is handed unopened directly to Rahauro on Magatha's behalf.
Savage troggs ambushed and killed Maur in the tunnels of Ragefire Chasm.
Rahauro is the contact on Elder Rise, while Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem gives the directive and authorizes the reward.

angles.text: The Grimtotem clan has an uneasy relationship with Cairne Bloodhoof's people. Any secret operation by Magatha's followers in Orgrimmar gives cause for suspicion.
Troggs and cultists threaten the tunnels beneath Orgrimmar. Grimtotem agents are also present beneath Thrall's fortress, raising unanswered political questions.
